{{recipe}}

Cracked pepper adds a nice texture difference between the creamy cheese, tender meat, and the toasted bun, and complements the chipotle mayo.

== Ingredients ==

=== Chipotle mayo ===
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 2–4 [[Cookbook:Chipotle Pepper|chipotle]] chiles, finely [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ teaspoon freshly-ground black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

=== Burgers ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] ground [[Cookbook:Chuck|chuck]] steak
* Salt
* ¼ cup cracked black [[Cookbook:Peppercorn|peppercorns]], plus more if needed
* 4 slices of your favorite smooth-melting [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (optional), room temperature
* [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 4 hamburger buns, halved

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] together all chipotle mayo ingredients until well combined. Refrigerate until needed.
#Shape beef into 4 equal patties. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] with Dijon mustard on both sides and sprinkle liberally with kosher salt on both sides.
#Place peppercorns in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]]. Press patties lightly on both sides into pepper. Set aside.
#Heat about 25 charcoal briquets in a large chimney starter. Reapply grate.
#Add burgers and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 143°F for medium rare, 157°F for medium, and 167°F for well/toast.
#Remove to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes. If using cheese, place one slice on top of each patty. Meanwhile, [[Cookbook:Toasting|toast]] buns on the grill.
#Spread buns with chipotle mayo. Add a patty on top of the bottom half of a bun and top with the other half. Serve warm.

Shape beef into 4 equal patties. Brush with Dijon mustard on both sides and sprinkle liberally with kosher salt on both sides.
Place peppercorns in a pie pan. Press patties lightly on both sides into pepper. Set aside.
Heat about 25 charcoal briquets in a large chimney starter. Reapply grate.
Add burgers and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 143°F for medium rare, 157°F for medium, and 167°F for well/toast.
